# Purpose

Import is separated from harmonization. CSV, TSV and JSON have native paths, while other common bibliographic formats can use bibliometrix when installed.

# Workflow

```{r}
d <- example_biblio()
x <- as_biblio_project(d, source = "teaching corpus")
head(x$works)
head(x$authorships)
head(x$keywords)
to_bibliometrix(x)
to_biblium(x)
```

# Interpretation

Results should be interpreted in relation to database coverage, time window, entity normalization and analytical thresholds. Provenance should be retained whenever data are merged, deduplicated or enriched.
